findings.observation: Direct message probes, word-match verdicts and cosine threshold do not establish indirect retrieval exposure or protected effects.
Expired-token example classifies general exceptions as SECURE.
HTTP failures can appear as absent KEV membership; EPSS threshold is converted into PoC evidence.
Decoding failure still emits verified true; expected provenance policy is not established by that output.
CycloneDX component identity drops bom-ref; lookup errors return empty lists; candidates can become findings without applicability verification.
Equal error strings can compare equal, absent baseline defaults to passing integrity, temporary manifest is written into restored data.
Candidate text already containing secret facts and similarity gaps do not independently demonstrate inversion/membership; direct database identity must be distinguished from the user API.
Removing shells/package managers indiscriminately is unsuitable for coding assistant workspaces.
